title: National Institutional Integrity, Public Asset Audit, and Review Commission Public Deliberation Plan
proposal: Enactment of the National Institutional Integrity, Public Asset Audit, and Review Commission Bill, 2026.

publication.plain_language_summary: Public summary explaining the asset audit process, rights safeguards under Article 20(1) and Article 311, and High Court review procedures.
publication.full_draft: Complete text of the Bill and explanatory memoranda.
publication.impact_notes: Explanatory note on public exchequer recovery, contractual rights, and civil service integrity.
publication.evidence_register: Register of CAG reports, Supreme Court judgments, and financial valuation methodologies.

participation.accessibility: Free online and postal submission options across all States
participation.anti_retaliation: Whistleblower protection and anonymous submission option

integrity.lobbying_disclosure: Mandatory disclosure of all corporate and organizational submissions
integrity.anti_capture: Independent oversight by multi-party selection committee
integrity.privacy: Protection of personal data under Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
integrity.automated_analysis_disclosure: Public reporting of submission categorization and methodology

deliberation.expert_hearings: Hearings with former Supreme Court judges, CAG auditors, and constitutional scholars
deliberation.civic_forums: Public hearings conducted by Joint Parliamentary Committee

response_to_comments.publication: Public Consultation Outcome Matrix published online

remedies.complaint_route: Petition to Joint Parliamentary Committee Secretariat
remedies.reconsultation_trigger: Substantive structural alteration to due process provisions
remedies.public_notice: Published in Gazette and online portal
